transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile support. My name is Toby. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Toby. I ordered a SIM-only deal and requested to port my old number across with a PAC code, but my old SIM went dead yesterday and my new S-Net SIM still hasn't picked up my number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly investigate why your mobile number port is delayed, Imogen. For account security, could you please verify your billing address and the security question answer on your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 19 St Peter's Court, Winchester, SO23 8BN. And my security question is my first car, which was a Ford Fiesta.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Imogen, that's verified your account. Could you please give me the mobile number you are transferring across, the PAC code, and the temporary number printed on your new S-Net SIM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The number I want to keep is 07911 234 567. The PAC code from my old provider is O2-948215-M. And the temporary mobile number on the S-Net SIM card packaging is 07700 900 481.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And tell me a little about the timeline of when the old SIM stopped working.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My old SIM disconnected at noon yesterday, and I'm in the middle of exchanging contracts on a house! My estate agent and solicitor are trying to call me, and having no mobile service right now is completely nerve-wracking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Having your mobile cut off while exchanging contracts on a home is extremely stressful, Imogen. I understand how urgent this is with solicitors trying to reach you, so let's get into the porting clearing house file and get this released.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Toby, that really means a lot because I've been panicking all morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your previous network disconnected your old number yesterday at noon following your PAC submission, but the number has not ported onto your new S-Net SIM, leaving you without incoming calls during a time-sensitive house exchange. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. It's showing No Service on the old phone and the temporary number is still active on the new phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Let me access the national Mobile Number Portability database. Bear with me for one moment while I query the clearing house server.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, standing by.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for bearing with me, Imogen. I see what happened. The port was submitted yesterday during the national clearing house maintenance window, so the electronic routing file got suspended in a pending status.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, so it's stuck in their computer system?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, precisely. The PAC code itself is completely valid, but the routing instruction to point the HLR database to S-Net's network didn't trigger automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you trigger it from your end, or do I have to wait days?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously network routing tables cannot be bypassed instantly, Imogen, but as a tier-two support agent I can perform a manual broadcast push right now to release the stuck queue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh brilliant, please do that!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am initiating the manual broadcast push through the clearing portal now. The system requires me to verify the target IMSI and temporary SIM details.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, whatever you need.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you tell me again what that temporary mobile number is that came on the new S-Net SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 07700 900 481, like I mentioned at the start of the call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Imogen. I've input 07700 900 481 and matched it to the SIM IMSI serial. The broadcast signal has just been sent across to the core mobile exchange.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does that usually take to push through?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The manual broadcast takes approximately sixty seconds. While we wait, let's keep your mobile phone in airplane mode for one minute to flush the cellular radio cache.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, turning on Airplane Mode now on my iPhone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. The portal is showing the porting status update: Status is changing from Suspended to Completed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, wonderful!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now please turn Airplane Mode off on your phone and allow the handset to scan for the local cellular cell tower.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Airplane Mode turned off... it's searching... and S-Net 5G just appeared in the top corner with four bars of signal!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just as a quick tip for your new S-Net SIM, have you downloaded our S-Net Mobile app to monitor your data usage and roaming allowances?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I haven't yet, but I'll make sure to download it from the App Store tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's very handy for checking remaining data, itemized bills, and setting up monthly spending caps so you never get unexpected charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's great to know, especially with all the phone calls I'm making at the moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your plan includes unlimited UK minutes and texts and thirty gigabytes of data, plus five gigabytes of inclusive roaming in the European Union.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that EU roaming inclusion will be so useful when we take our holiday in France next summer.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it activates automatically when your handset registers on a European partner carrier like Orange or SFR.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's such a relief to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also, just to check on your handset, are all four signal bars still showing steadily without dropping to three?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, solid four bars on 5G.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's verify SMS delivery. Could you send a quick test text message to a family member or friend to confirm outbound messaging?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm sending a quick text message to my partner now... it says Delivered instantly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did you want to configure your personal voicemail PIN while we are on the line?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I access voicemail on S-Net mobile?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You simply press and hold key number one on your phone dialer, or dial 222 directly. It will prompt you to choose a four-digit security PIN.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds very straightforward. I'll set that up right after our call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. Now let's verify incoming routing. I am going to dial your ported number, 07911 234 567, from my test console right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, waiting for the call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Placing the outbound test call now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's ringing! My phone is ringing with your incoming call!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And when you accept the call, is the voice connection clear?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Accepting... hello Toby! Yes, it's ringing through to my handset on my actual number!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the porting routing has fully updated across the UK cellular network. Your original number is now active on your new S-Net SIM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can't tell you how relieved I am. Now my solicitor and mortgage broker can reach me without any issues.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so glad we could get that unblocked for you so quickly today, Imogen. Is there anything else on your mobile account I can assist with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that was the big worry and it's completely sorted. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Imogen. Best of luck with the house exchange and have a wonderful day!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Toby, goodbye!
